history_summary: Record native species-reference correspondence for B8-1 in PAH Consortium 2.
history_details: The B8-1 species descriptor receives native Bacillus_A paramycoides correspondence from a nine-genome reference population with fraction 1.0. This reference population does not establish the B8-1 experimental stock assembly. Preserve B8-1/A3 Consortium 2, the existing unselected A3 mapping, 16S marker uncertainty, the seven-day naphthalene removal endpoint and the distinct planktonic and static-biofilm settings. Bacillus_A is a lineage label difference, not formal stock renaming. Existing source/assay/optimization/marker findings 2317-2319 remain distinct. Only one selected GTDB block/status and two native inline events changed. The pinned table has no verified upstream release label. All prior history remains unchanged; this bounded technical correction does not complete scientific review or corpus QC.
